profile.headline: Software Engineer at Block
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of delivering software products.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer leading Cash App Card feature development across two teams, owning architecture and cross-team execution while coordinating with Product, Design, Compliance, and other stakeholders.

Delivered multiple customer-facing launches and platform quality improvements, including:

- Afterpay on Cash App Card: led end-to-end delivery of “pay over time” on card transactions (Cash App’s first credit card–like product)

- Reliability & end-to-end testing: Drove the org-wide E2E testing strategy, standardizing coverage, tooling, and release gating to improve reliability.

- Merchant blocking: built customer controls to improve trust and reduce unwanted merchant transactions

- Transaction authentication: built suspicious-transaction detection with push-notification step-up verification (“Is this you?”) to prevent unauthorized spend and improve safety
positions.insights: Technical Leadership, Distributed Systems and +5 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on bringing voice commanding and transcription to Office Online products (Word Online and PowerPoint Online)

positions.title: Software Engineer, Software Engineer 2
positions.description: Owned text input, IME input, and typing performance areas in Word for Windows. Worked on a huge (millions of lines of code), challenging C/C++ codebase with over 30 years of history.
